summary: The hole in the budget: In your first week, {budget director} shows you the deficit you inherited.
realLife: One life: Sworn in as California governor just after midnight in 1967, he found a shortfall, froze hiring and ordered cuts, then signed what was called the largest tax increase proposed by any governor. Another: Facing an inherited deficit in 1975, she laid off state workers and returned her own raise. Another: He inherited a deficit in 1934 and cut more than 1,000 positions in his first year.
gates: An executive office in your first weeks.
A deficit on the budget record.
choices: freeze hiring and cut every department
cut your own perks and pay first

branches.then: The tax you said you would not raise is the only way left.
The people laid off are names in your place.
You push them out of the jobs they hold.
